31→func ReconstructDataColumnSidecars(verifiedRoSidecars []blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn) ([]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn, error) {
    32→	// Check if there is at least one input sidecar.
    33→	if len(verifiedRoSidecars) == 0 {
    34→		return nil, ErrNotEnoughDataColumnSidecars
    35→	}
    36→
    37→	// Safely retrieve the first sidecar as a reference.
    38→	referenceSidecar := verifiedRoSidecars[0]
    39→
    40→	// Check if all columns have the same length and are commmitted to the same block.
    41→	blobCount := len(referenceSidecar.Column)
    42→	blockRoot := referenceSidecar.BlockRoot()
    43→	for _, sidecar := range verifiedRoSidecars[1:] {
    44→		if len(sidecar.Column) != blobCount {
    45→			return nil, ErrColumnLengthsDiffer
    46→		}
    47→
    48→		if sidecar.BlockRoot() != blockRoot {
    49→			return nil, ErrBlockRootMismatch
    50→		}
    51→	}
    52→
    53→	// Deduplicate sidecars.
    54→	sidecarByIndex := make(map[uint64]blocks.VerifiedRODataColumn, len(verifiedRoSidecars))
    55→	for _, inVerifiedRoSidecar := range verifiedRoSidecars {
    56→		sidecarByIndex[inVerifiedRoSidecar.Index] = inVerifiedRoSidecar
    57→	}
    58→
    59→	// Check if there is enough sidecars to reconstruct the missing columns.
    60→	sidecarCount := len(sidecarByIndex)
    61→	if uint64(sidecarCount) < MinimumColumnCountToReconstruct() {
    62→		return nil, ErrNotEnoughDataColumnSidecars
    63→	}
    64→
    65→	// Sidecars are verified and are committed to the same block.
    66→	// All signed block headers, KZG commitments, and inclusion proofs are the same.
    67→	signedBlockHeader := referenceSidecar.SignedBlockHeader
    68→	kzgCommitments := referenceSidecar.KzgCommitments
    69→	kzgCommitmentsInclusionProof := referenceSidecar.KzgCommitmentsInclusionProof
    70→
    71→	// Recover cells and compute proofs in parallel.
    72→	var wg errgroup.Group
    73→	cellsAndProofs := make([]kzg.CellsAndProofs, blobCount)
    74→	for blobIndex := range uint64(blobCount) {
    75→		wg.Go(func() error {
    76→			cellsIndices := make([]uint64, 0, sidecarCount)
    77→			cells := make([]kzg.Cell, 0, sidecarCount)
    78→
    79→			for columnIndex, sidecar := range sidecarByIndex {
    80→				cell := sidecar.Column[blobIndex]
    81→				cells = append(cells, kzg.Cell(cell))
    82→				cellsIndices = append(cellsIndices, columnIndex)
    83→			}
    84→
    85→			// Recover the cells and proofs for the corresponding blob
    86→			cellsAndProofsForBlob, err := kzg.RecoverCellsAndKZGProofs(cellsIndices, cells)
    87→
    88→			if err != nil {
    89→				return errors.Wrapf(err, "recover cells and KZG proofs for blob %d", blobIndex)
    90→			}
    91→
    92→			// It is safe for multiple goroutines to concurrently write to the same slice,
    93→			// as long as they are writing to different indices, which is the case here.
    94→			cellsAndProofs[blobIndex] = cellsAndProofsForBlob
    95→			return nil
    96→		})
    97→	}
    98→
    99→	if err := wg.Wait(); err != nil {
   100→		return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "wait for RecoverCellsAndKZGProofs")
   101→	}
   102→
   103→	reconstructedSidecars, err := dataColumnsSidecars(signedBlockHeader, kzgCommitments, kzgCommitmentsInclusionProof, cellsAndProofs)

   105→		return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "data column sidecars from items")
   106→	}
